insight: Founded by two Google Translate alumni; in Feb 2026 the Pentagon's CDAO contracted LILT for military-wide AI translation.
name: LILT
tagline: Enterprise AI translation with an adaptive engine and built-in human verification.
description: An enterprise and government translation platform built around an in-house Contextual AI engine — interactive, adaptive machine translation that learns from translator feedback in real time instead of classic post-editing. Pairs the AI with a verified human-expert layer, compliance options up to IL6+ for government work, and an API plus connector framework for CMS and localization workflows.

modelSupport.notes: In-house adaptive Contextual AI engine; the connector layer can also route Google Translate, DeepL, or Amazon Translate.

edge: Its Contextual AI learns from each translator edit in real time with verified human review built in — adaptive where raw-MT rivals are static.
pros: Engine adapts to translator edits in real time
IL6+ gov compliance and managed deployments
Full API plus CMS connector framework
cons: No free tier — sales-led procurement only
Web and API only; no desktop or mobile apps
Overkill for individuals vs instant MT tools
